title: Full Metal Furies is in the OpenPak catalogue as a beta
body: Full Metal Furies, the action game, is now listed in the OpenPak catalogue as a beta. Compatibility testing is still under way, so we cannot yet promise every part of the game works as it should on OpenPak. We will update this post as testing moves forward. Until then, expect a build that is still being checked.
footer: OpenPak Full Metal Furies — beta, not promised.
